context_requirements: Functional nicotinic or muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (e.g., CHRNA7, CHRM3) expressed on the cell surface
Intact downstream signaling (PI3K/Akt, NF-κB, AMPK, Nrf2, CREB)
Presence of inflammatory or oxidative stress stimuli to reveal anti-inflammatory/antioxidant effects
Cholinergic receptor expression is generally low in the nine tested cancer cell lines
falsifiers: No significant transcriptional changes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Changes that are equally observed with vehicle or unrelated drug classes
Lack of dose-dependent response at 10 µM
Absence of expected downstream pathway modulation (e.g., no NF-κB or AMPK signature)

evidence.supports: α7 nAChR agonist reduces neuroinflammation and oxidative stress in mice
α7 nAChR agonist GTS-21 mitigates cognitive impairment and neuroinflammation
α7 nAChR agonist PNU-282987 suppresses oxidative stress and activates AMPK in liver
GTS-21 inhibits NF-κB and upregulates Nrf2, CREB, PPARγ in microglia
α7 nAChR agonist PNU-282987 improves cognition via p-CREB and BDNF
